scope: Updated friendly two-page guide and reusable copy only. No production app source, installed app, personal captures or user settings changed.

native_provenance.fixture_privacy: Fictional temporary archive and isolated preferences. No personal captures, clipboard reads/writes, network requests, installed-app actions or notifications. Code-drawn landscape fixture, no KARI material.
native_provenance.render_execution: Initial sandbox run could not connect to macOS window services and timed out. Scoped host-access retry exported five assets and exited successfully; own windows were closed.

visual_review.method: Both final PDF pages rendered by Poppler at 180 dpi and inspected at original 2105x1489 resolution after the final copy/layout changes.
checks: No authored text overlap, clipping or overflow.
Numbered page-one badges avoid native controls and remain inside page margins.
Wide native Search excerpt shows two dates, query and filters clearly; image card is intentionally cropped by the PDF.
Priority wording is color-coded and retains readable Low/Medium/High labels.
Consistent headings, embedded typography, footer version, page numbering and friendly robot artwork.
Optional Auto Capture and Reduce Motion behavior are distinct from first steps; no universal drag or App Store availability promise.

limitations: Native assets are linked to the verified Store QA module, not compared to a distribution-signed upload.
Physical external drag completion is not established by this guide; copy limits the claim to destinations accepting the content.
This is a two-page quick guide, not a full feature manual or App Store approval.
rebuild_note: Any later PDF or authoring input change invalidates this review until both pages are rendered and inspected again.
